checks.unitsAndDenominators: Actual target/sample numerators divide by global denominator, not owner size. 423 real coordinates; two ranks pad one non-parameter zero. Logical eight-byte padded remote copies are separate from JSON serialization, heap memory, scalar synchronization and transport time.
checks.modelAssumptions: One synthetic decoder and fixed logical ranks; explicit owner-local optimizer algebra, shared clipping, immutable full source/diagnostic snapshots and all-gather replicas. No physically distributed runtime or measured memory savings.
checks.claimQualifiers: Logical restart is distinguished from real worker-group restart; no speed or large-model effectiveness claim.
checks.dependencyAndVisualScope: Actual lifecycle gradients and retained optimizer feed inspectable owner slices and payloads. New UI exposes explicit shard barrier; one-action commit compatibility uses the same computed collectives. Existing serving handoff remains intact; factory JSON-byte fixtures must refresh.
